hypotheses.risk: stop beyond breakout extreme by 0.10 ATR; actual-fill stop width 0.50-1.50 ATR; reward must be at least 4x estimated round-trip friction; one trade per squeeze episode

ai_policy: AI may only APPROVE or REJECT a mechanically complete candidate. It may not change direction, entry, stop, target, size, leverage, or create a trade. Provider failure means REJECT. Historical tests measure the mechanical queue, not AI skill.

promotion_gates.development_to_validation: PF >1.05, net PnL >0, at least 40 fills
promotion_gates.validation_to_retrospective_evaluation: base PF >1.10, stress PF >=1.00, at least 20 base fills, at least 2/3 symbols net positive, no symbol >60% gross profit
promotion_gates.paper_to_live: at least 200 prospective candidates, 100 AI APPROVE decisions, three full frozen months, PF >=1.25 base and >=1.10 stress, expectancy >=0.10R, 95% session-block bootstrap lower bound >0, max DD <=4%, AI APPROVE cohort better than counterfactual REJECT cohort

execution.one_global_position: single global minute event loop with one shared cash balance, pending order and open position across the correlated ETH/SOL/BNB cluster
execution.ambiguous_bar: stop first; no favorable exit on limit fill minute

selection: Exactly H1 and H2 central configurations. No grid search. A failing gate stops that route; choose no least-bad winner. Simultaneous candidates use fixed liquidity priority ETH, then SOL, then BNB, but an execution-ineligible candidate falls through to the next candidate.
stress_semantics: Stress and severe are deployability replays: higher costs and limit penetration are known before entry, so the 4x friction filter is reapplied and the fill cohort may shrink. A smaller severe loss is not evidence of robustness and is not a matched-cohort cost shock.
audit_amendments: v1 used 180-minute admission spacing for both routes. Audit identified possible overlap when H2 filled near the end of its 30-minute TTL; that run was invalidated.
v1.1 replaced spacing with 210 minutes for H2, but independent per-symbol cash accounts still were not a true portfolio; that run was also invalidated before acceptance.

v1.2 uses one global minute event loop, enforces the stop-width cap at actual fill, records setup_id/evidence, and changes H2 from same-bar BTC non-confirmation to cumulative session-level SMT. These are audit corrections, not result-driven parameter tuning.
disclosure: No profit is promised. Bollinger Bands are a falsifiable volatility/location hypothesis. Existing months are retrospective because earlier research already inspected them.
